title: My Daily Routine
description: Practise the present simple and write about your typical day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I ___ up at seven o'clock every day.
exercises.explanation: With I, you, we and they, use the base verb with no -s: I get up.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
answers: watches
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, verbs ending in -ch, -sh, -s, -x or -o add -es: he watches.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I have breakfast at half past seven.
At half past seven I have breakfast.
exercises.explanation: Subject + verb + object + time: I have breakfast at half past seven. The time phrase can also go at the start.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: She go to school by bus.
answers: She goes to school by bus.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, add -s or -es to the verb: she goes.

exercises.prompt: Choose the best word to join the ideas.
exercises.text: I get up early on Monday, ___ I get up late on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two different or opposite ideas: early on Monday, but late on Sunday.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
answers: doesn't work
does not work
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, make the negative with doesn't (does not) + base verb: she doesn't work.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I go to bed ___ nine o'clock.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times: at nine o'clock.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: When do your sister get up?
answers: When does your sister get up?
exercises.explanation: Use "does" in questions with he, she and it: When does your sister get up?

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: I always ___ (have) a shower in the morning.
answers: have
exercises.explanation: With I, you, we and they, use the base form of the verb: I have.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like listening to music in the evening.
In the evening I like listening to music.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like listening to music.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I do my homework ___ the afternoon.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with parts of the day: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We brush our tooth after breakfast.
answers: We brush our teeth after breakfast.
exercises.explanation: The plural of "tooth" is "teeth".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I have breakfast and ___ I go to school.
exercises.explanation: Use "then" to show what happens next.

exercises.prompt: Complete with his, her or their.
exercises.text: My brother walks ___ dog after school.
answers: his
exercises.explanation: Use "his" for something that belongs to a boy or man: his dog.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I usually walk to school.
Usually I walk to school.
exercises.explanation: Put "usually" before the main verb: I usually walk.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My school day are very long.
answers: My school day is very long.
My school days are very long.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing (my school day) and "are" with more than one.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ do you go to school? By bus.
exercises.explanation: Use "How" to ask about the way you do something or travel: How do you go? By bus.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My dad finishs work at five o'clock.
answers: My dad finishes work at five o'clock.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, verbs ending in -sh take -es: he finishes.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I can't get up late on school days.
On school days I can't get up late.
exercises.explanation: Subject + can't + verb: I can't get up late.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: My sister ___ (do) her homework after dinner.
answers: does
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, "do" becomes "does": she does her homework.

task.prompt: Write about your typical school day.
contentPoints: Say what time you get up.
Say what you do in the morning.
Say what you do after school.
Say what time you go to bed.
task.modelAnswer: I get up at seven o'clock. I have a shower and then I eat breakfast. I go to school by bus. After school I do my homework and I play football. In the evening I watch TV with my family. I go to bed at half past nine.
